items.metric: LIVE GMV (week Sep 14 to 20, third week of decline, largest fall in the set)
items.effect: Streams held near 103 while LIVE GMV collapsed, so GMV per stream fell to roughly 3.64 from about 17.38.
items.action: Re-brief the creators holding the top streams, alldaysteals carries the bidet stream, and hold stream count near 90 to 100 until GMV per stream recovers above 10.

items.metric: Collab invites sent (third week of decline, upstream of sampling)
items.effect: Invites halved while 9,585 DMs went out, so inbound interest cannot refill the sample stage for early October.
items.action: Restart invites toward the prior week's 12,221 using the existing outreach lists and check why daily rows show zero invites on Sep 18 and Sep 19.

items.metric: Sample requests (third week of decline, feeds October content)
items.effect: Requests fell to 68 while only 16 shipped and 12 were delivered, so the October creator pipeline is smaller than September's.
items.action: Clear the 26 To Review requests today, highest post rate first, and re-screen the 84 expired items for creators who still post.

items.metric: GMV (fourth consecutive decline, with three week runs in Orders, Units, Affiliate GMV, LIVE GMV, DMs, Collab invites, Sample requests and Samples delivered)
items.effect: The week closed at 602.63 GMV per day against 1,030.93, and Affiliate GMV at 79.5% of the total fell in step, so this is a level shift not a partial week.
items.action: Track the Sep 21 to 27 week against the 602.63 daily run and treat sample approvals and shipping as the only levers that reach October GMV.

items.metric: GMV Max Back to School campaign ROAS against its 5.4 target
items.effect: The campaign spent 289.66 for 83.97 of revenue, a 205.69 loss before commission and COGS, on 3 orders, while Shop Wide also sits below target at 1.15 against 2.0.
items.action: Cap or pause the Back to School campaign and move its 289.66 of weekly spend to Screen Door at 2.00, the only campaign clear of breakeven.

items.metric: Sample pipeline rejection rate (160 of 300 window requests, against the 09-24 read of 55.3%)
items.effect: More than half of inbound sample demand is still discarded while 84 requests sit expired and 26 await review, so content supply into November stays capped.
items.action: Screen on post rate and GPM before rejecting and work the expired backlog for creators who still post.
